coordinate_space: Relative to an upright 1000x630 canonical card. rect is [x, y, w, h].
calibration_note: All v4 boxes are carried over unchanged. The interrupted draft's birth_date_printed region was removed because the audited layout does not independently confirm that semantic. The only retained v5 change is correcting card_serial_number from digits to latin_serial; its box is unchanged.

semantic_policy.full_name: Compose later from name_line_1 and name_line_2.
semantic_policy.date_of_birth: The front prints the birth date at YEAR/MONTH precision beside the eagle emblem. Two ordered candidate boxes are declared because rectification registers that print to about +/-20 px; the first whose text parses as a real date is used, and the comparison precision is recorded on the check. A date decoded from national-ID digits is still labelled derived - the printed field is a second observation, not a replacement.
semantic_policy.gender: The back prints gender independently. Digit 13 of the national ID encodes the same fact, so the two are cross-checkable.
semantic_policy.national_id_number: The same 14-digit number is printed on both the front and the back. When both sides of one physical card are supplied, the two readings are cross-checkable.
semantic_policy.validation: Format and structural checks may produce structurally_valid. Agreement between readings from the same card is card_internal_consensus evidence, not verification. externally_verified requires independent applicant data. No checksum is implemented or claimed.

front.description: Upright front: portrait at left, two name lines and two address lines at right, national ID across the lower-right band, serial at lower left.

regions.name: birth_date_printed_a
regions.note: Printed YYYY/MM immediately left of the eagle emblem, above the serial. Left-registered of two candidate boxes: the rectification registers this print to about +/-20 px, and no single box holds the full date on every card while excluding the emblem. Audited on all five accepted front crops; see reports/phase2d_b_birth_date_region_audit.md.

regions.name: birth_date_printed_b
regions.note: Same print as birth_date_printed_a, shifted right for cards whose rectification sits further right. The first candidate whose text parses as a real date is the one the birth-date cross-check uses.

regions.name: national_id_number
regions.note: Covers the full lower-right number and excludes the left security panel.

regions.name: card_serial_number
regions.note: The serial is printed in Latin capitals and Western digits, not in Arabic-Indic numerals like every other numeric field on this card. v4 declared it `digits`, which routed it to the `ara` model and to Arabic-Indic folding; measured on the five accepted fronts, that returned one or two stray digits on all five, while `eng` under the Latin charset returned the complete serial on four of five. The content type is corrected here to `latin_serial`.

back.description: Upright back: numeric identifier in the top band, a two-line occupation/qualification field, three distinct status values, expiry value, and a separate non-OCR barcode area.

regions.name: occupation
regions.note: One semantic field printed across two lines.

regions.name: expiry_date
regions.note: Date value next to the visually distinct validity label. No issue-date region is declared because no separate label/value pair was confirmed.
